items.title: Notre Dame completes 2027 football schedule with addition of Virginia
items.summary: Notre Dame had one open spot left for its 2027 football schedule, and now that spot is filled. On Wednesday, it was announced that the Irish will travel to Charlottesville to take on the Virginia Cavaliers at Scott Stadium. Notre Dame will now have 6 ACC games in 2027.
